items.title: Ambassadors' In-House AI Workflow Platform Available to All
items.rationale: Concrete new release: Amsterdam studio Ambassadors opens its in-house visual AI workflow platform Mosa to everyone, a tool production teams can try now.
items.excerpt: Amsterdam-based creative production company Ambassadors has made its in-house visual AI workflow platform Mosa available now to all.

items.title: Roundup: New software for video editors by Iain Anderson
items.rationale: Hands-on roundup of new small editor utilities made possible by AI-written code; editors get specific tools to adopt tomorrow.
items.excerpt: Artificial Intelligence isn't good at everything, but it is good at writing code. In general, the areas in which it excels are the technical ones, where it succeeds at complex code-driven tasks, and the areas where it struggles are the easy ones. Small-scale software tools sit right in the sweet spot.

items.title: Can Art House Theaters Use AI-Driven Data Models to Reach a More Targeted Audience?
items.rationale: New partnership: Laemmle's 'Inside the Arthouse' teams with data firm Chronicle to use AI audience models, a practical distribution/marketing use case for indie film.
items.excerpt: The podcast "Inside the Arthouse" with Greg Laemmle and Raphael Sbarge partnered with data company Chronicle to bring their reach to the next level.
